name: PearlDriver NLAMM unchecked buy() cost overflow
summary: NLAMM.buy(token,index,amount) runs inside an unchecked block and charges amount * currentPrice in USDT, then mints amount * 1e18 game tokens. Choosing amount so the product wraps let the attacker pay fractions of a cent for up to 1e63 tokens of five craft resources, which it sold into their PearlDEX USDT pairs in the same transaction; two later actors repeated the overflow before the implementation was replaced.
notes: ProxyAdmin 0xf07fe21037556a27a33a0662a49373f1a3bb092d upgrade (0x99a88ec4) by 0xbc9d5a23f2e55286650aae5573c524703aeb4724 replaced the initial implementation 0x5bb5e880479b3a39b10baf04f724e1d8ceb2021e with NLAMM 0x1903d672; the next upgrade (block 82160602) came after the exploit.

USDT paid out of PearlDEX pairs (factory 0x73a0ba8bac1b6ae00de1e9cf767cdb98075ab92e) for overflow-minted tokens, per campaign; no USDT flowed into those pairs from the attackers in these transactions. The fractional USDT paid to NLAMM for the mints is attacker input and is not subtracted. BSC-USD valued at par.
